function drawPriceChart(canvasId, priceData, color) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  
  const data = priceData.slice(-20);
  if (data.length < 2) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('数据不足', W/2, H/2);
    return;
  }
  
  const prices = data.map(d => d.price);
  const minP = Math.min(...prices) * 0.98;
  const maxP = Math.max(...prices) * 1.02;
  const range = maxP - minP || 1;
  
  const pad = { top: 8, bottom: 12, left: 4, right: 4 };
  const chartW = W - pad.left - pad.right;
  const chartH = H - pad.top - pad.bottom;
  
  // Draw line
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < prices.length; i++) {
    const x = pad.left + (i / (prices.length - 1)) * chartW;
    const y = pad.top + chartH - ((prices[i] - minP) / range) * chartH;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Draw current price
  const lastPrice = prices[prices.length - 1];
  const prevPrice = prices[prices.length - 2] || lastPrice;
  const chg = lastPrice - prevPrice;
  const chgPct = ((chg / prevPrice) * 100).toFixed(2);
  const chgText = (chg >= 0 ? '+' : '') + chgPct + '%';
  
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(lastPrice.toFixed(2), pad.left + 2, pad.top + 10);
  
  ctx.fillStyle = chg >= 0 ? '#4caf50' : '#f44336';
  ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(chgText, pad.left + 2, pad.top + 22);
}

function drawPriceChart(canvasId, priceData, color) {
  const canvas = typeof canvasId === 'string' ? document.getElementById(canvasId) : canvasId;
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  
  const data = (priceData || []).slice(-20);
  if (data.length < 2) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
    ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('等待数据...', W/2, H/2);
    return;
  }
  
  const prices = data.map(function(d) { return d.price; });
  const minP = Math.min.apply(null, prices) * 0.98;
  const maxP = Math.max.apply(null, prices) * 1.02;
  const range = maxP - minP || 1;
  
  var pad = { top: 4, bottom: 4, left: 4, right: 4 };
  var chartW = W - pad.left - pad.right;
  var chartH = H - pad.top - pad.bottom;
  
  // Background grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    var y = pad.top + (chartH / 4) * i;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pad.left, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W - pad.right, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  
  // Price line
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.strokeStyle = color || '#4fc3f7';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  for (var i = 0; i < prices.length; i++) {
    var x = pad.left + (i / (prices.length - 1)) * chartW;
    var y = pad.top + chartH - ((prices[i] - minP) / range) * chartH;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Last price & change
  var lastPrice = prices[prices.length - 1];
  var prevPrice = prices.length >= 2 ? prices[prices.length - 2] : lastPrice;
  var chg = lastPrice - prevPrice;
  var chgPct = prevPrice !== 0 ? ((chg / prevPrice) * 100).toFixed(2) : '0.00';
  var chgText = (chg >= 0 ? '+' : '') + chgPct + '%';
  
  ctx.fillStyle = color || '#4fc3f7';
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(lastPrice.toFixed(2), pad.left + 2, pad.top + 11);
  
  ctx.fillStyle = chg >= 0 ? '#4caf50' : '#f44336';
  ctx.font = '9px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(chgText, pad.left + 2, pad.top + 22);
}
